title: Stasis & Vellum
description: A dark surreal scene depicts a mysterious shop entrance named 'STASIS & VELLUM SPELLS FOR THE LOCKED HOUR' during a heavy rainstorm. The doorway is framed by giant red-capped mushrooms, glowing green aurora in the sky, and corn stalks growing from blood-red soil, with various magical posters, a large corn cob, potion bottles, and a 'LOCKED HOUR FORMULA' sign visible.
